caption: A Squad is a team of AI agents
line: A Squad is a small team of AI agents working on one goal together.

caption: Persona: a role, a model tier, instructions
line: A Persona is one agent profile: a role, a model tier, and instructions.

caption: Squad: a named group of Personas
line: A Squad is a named group of Personas. Each Persona fills a slot, and each slot becomes a worker in the run.

caption: The Orchestrator plans; workers take steps
line: One of them, the Orchestrator, plans the work and keeps it moving. The others are workers that each take steps.

caption: Five built-in Squads, ready to use
line: Zana ships five built-in Squads, so you can start without building anything.

caption: Squad: work that splits into pieces. Single agent: small, step-by-step tasks
line: Reach for a Squad when the work splits into pieces that can run side by side. For small, step-by-step tasks, a single agent is simpler.

caption: Flow view: each agent, its status, and hand-offs
line: While a Squad runs, Flow view shows each agent, its status, and how work is handed off. Here, the run is waiting on you.

caption: A Squad that needs a decision asks in your Inbox
line: When a Squad needs a decision, it asks in your Inbox.

caption: Answer, and it carries on; the result is posted to the Inbox
line: Answer it, and the Squad carries on. When it finishes, the result is posted to the Inbox too.

caption: Squad details: what each agent did
line: Open Squad details to see what each agent did.

caption: A person reviews the result
line: A finished run isn't a guarantee. A person reviews the result, so always read it yourself.
